description: Reference incompressible DNS of the 3D Taylor-Green vortex at Re=1600 (1st International Workshop on High-Order CFD Methods, problem C3.5; reused as BS1 in later workshops). Per the C3.5 problem sheet: dealiased pseudo-spectral code developed at Universite catholique de Louvain (UCL), 512^3 modes, low-storage 3-step Runge-Kutta (Williamson 1980), dimensionless time step 1.0e-3; grid convergence for a spectral discretization also shown by van Rees et al. (2011). Initial condition u=V0 sin(x/L)cos(y/L)cos(z/L), v=-V0 cos(x/L)sin(y/L)cos(z/L), w=0 on a periodic box of side 2*pi*L; all values non-dimensionalised with V0 and L (t by L/V0, Ek by V0^2, eps by V0^3/L, enstrophy by V0^2/L^2).
columns: E: volume-averaged kinetic energy Ek = (1/|Omega|) int v.v/2 dOmega, file column 2
dissipation: kinetic energy dissipation rate eps = -dEk/dt, file column 3
enstrophy: volume-averaged enstrophy (1/|Omega|) int w.w/2 dOmega, file column 4 (eps = 2*nu*enstrophy for incompressible flow)
notes: Parsed unmodified from the raw file (2000 rows, t = 0.00..19.99 in steps of 0.01; no t=20.00 row). Column meanings are taken from the file header and from Section 9 of the C3.5 problem sheet ('spectral Re1600 512.gdiag provides the evolution of dimensionless values of Ek, eps = -dEk/dt and E [enstrophy]'). Consistency checks done on the parsed data: column 3 agrees with a centred finite difference of column 2 to <1e-7 relative, and with 2*nu*column 4 (nu=1/1600) to <3e-5 relative; E(0)=0.125, enstrophy(0)=0.375 as expected for this initial condition. Peak dissipation in the file: eps = 0.012857528187 at t = 8.97 (enstrophy peak 10.2861271303 at the same sample). Provenance caveat: the workshop sheet attributes this file to the UCL pseudo-spectral code (not literally to van Rees et al.'s code); van Rees et al. (2011) is cited by the sheet for an independent spectral grid-convergence study of the same flow. Companion files from the same directory saved alongside: wn_slice_x0_08000.out (512x512 float64 vorticity norm on x/L=-pi at t=8, raw binary), read_and_plot_w.py (workshop reader script, not executed), case_c3.5.pdf (problem sheet).
